title: WidgetsBundle
description: A JSON value representing the Widget Bundle.

id.description: JSON object with the Widget Bundle Id. Specify this field to update the Widget Bundle. Referencing non-existing Widget Bundle Id will cause error. Omit this field to create new Widget Bundle.

createdTime.description: Timestamp of the Widget Bundle creation, in milliseconds

alias.description: Unique alias that is used in widget types as a reference widget bundle

title.description: Title used in search and UI

image.description: Relative or external image URL. Replaced with image data URL (Base64) in case of relative URL and 'inlineImages' option enabled.

name.description: Same as title of the Widget Bundle. Read-only field. Update the 'title' to change the 'name' of the Widget Bundle.

id.description: ID of the entity, time-based UUID v1
